subject.title: [Feature]: Support Anthropic native server-side tools (web_search, web_fetch, code_execution)

question: Should OpenClaw support Anthropic API-key server-side tools as an Anthropic provider/plugin-owned opt-in, and should the first accepted slice be only native web search or the broader web_fetch/code_execution/PTC design?
rationale: The request adds provider-specific config/API surface plus hosted web and code execution semantics that affect security, billing, session replay, and plugin ownership; automation cannot choose that product boundary safely.

options.title: Keep broad tracker, design slices first
options.body: Keep this issue open and require a maintainer-approved design that separates web_search, web_fetch, code_execution/PTC, allowed_callers, and server-result replay before implementation.

options.title: Narrow to web search only
options.body: Let https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/49949 own native web_search and split or defer the remaining server-tool capabilities into separate issues.

options.title: Reject core support for now
options.body: Close this direction unless it can be expressed through an external plugin/API extension with no new core/provider surface.

recommendation.title: Keep broad tracker, design slices first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require a maintainer-approved design that separates web_search, web_fetch, code_execution/PTC, allowed_callers, and server-result replay before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest recent history across Anthropic transport, provider plugin metadata, config, and prior maintainer review comments for this issue family.
